title: fix(lint): warn on a stored computed field whose expression reads another record, the clock or the acting user (#32529, #32554)
body:
Fixes #32529
Fixes #32554

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #32703 — skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md and skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md teach a stored field carrying a formula's `expression` and say nothing of a cross-record or a volatile input, both now warned; the hand-written docs half is in this diff (`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`, `field-types.mdx`, `validation-rules.mdx`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:存储型计算字段(非 `formula`、带 `expression`)的表达式如果读了**关联记录**的值(如请假单读 `record.employee.daily_hours`,或标题读 `record.?owner_id.?name`),或读了 `today()` / `now()`、当前用户、`can()`,`os validate` / `os build` 和对象保存口现在都给出**警告**(不拒收),并说明这个值只在本条记录写入时算一次。关联字段按注册表实际提供的定义判断:平台注入的 `owner_id`、`created_by`、`updated_by` 与对象扩展加的字段都算。公式字段读同样的输入不报。
- 为什么改:存储型字段只在本行写入时算一次;关联记录后来改了不会重算(实测应为 30 的值停在 40),读时钟或当前用户的值也停在写入那一刻,而作者面此前什么都不说。裁决 6816315099 允许「拒收或提示」;席位修订 6821360087 改为提示,因为第一方有 1 处有意这样存储的标题(HotCRM `display_title`),且偏差可用 `os migrate stored-expressions --changed` 修复。
- 风险与回滚:不收紧任何已接受的写法,只多两条警告;保存口只多一条提示,不会 422。仓内第一方存量 0 处;仓外第一方 1 处(HotCRM `forecast.object.ts:152`),现在会收到警告、不被拒。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.ts`(两条判定与提示文案),`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`(`fieldDefs`:按注册表提供的字段与注入列判断关联),`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`(保存口只给提示)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件 30 个用例全过:请假单读 `record.employee.daily_hours`、未声明的 `record.owner_id.name` 各得一条警告,`ownership: 'none'` 的对象不报 `owner_id`,保存口只给提示没有 422。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **New member `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.ts`**, called from the field-formula pass (`judgeFieldFormula` in `validate-expressions.ts`) on every field that is not a `formula` and declares an `expression` — the engine's own test for a stored computed field (`planStoredExpressions`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`). Both findings are **warnings** (the lane's revised call 6821360087): the build passes, and the object save door answers them as advisories, never a 422.
  - `stored-expression-cross-record-input` (#32529): a read through a reference field of the object **as the registry serves it** (`referenceTargetOf` through `analyzeRelationshipTraversals`, the engine's own hop reader; `record.a.b`, `record.?a.?b`, `record['a'].b`). The field index is the served body (`objectsAsServed`, object-extension fields folded in, a two-package tie left out), then the declared fields, then the injected columns (`injectedColumnDefsFor`: `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by` are lookups to `sys_user`), never shadowing a declared field. The reference itself and its `id` are not counted. The remedy names a `formula` (read time, not totallable), a snapshot field written by a flow on the related object, and `os migrate stored-expressions --changed` to repair drift — never a `summary`, which rolls children up and cannot carry a parent value down (triage 6819979060).
  - `stored-expression-volatile-input` (#32554): the clock functions `now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow()`, `daysAgo()` (`registerBoundStdLib`); the acting user under `current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user` (`buildScope`), the index spellings `ctx['user']` / `os['user']` included; the permission methods `can()`, `hasCapability()`. Not counted: `os.org`, `label()`, a comprehension variable named like a root.
- **Rule ids.** `ExprIssue` gains an optional `rule`; the `validateStackExpressions` entry maps `i.rule ?? EXPRESSION_INVALID` (`authoring-rules.ts`, one line). The two ids are exported from the barrel and explained in `os explain` (`rule-explanations.ts`, both entries say warning).
- **Docs.** One clause each on the two inputs in `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` (the composite-title sentence), `field-types.mdx` (`expression` on a stored field) and `validation-rules.mdx` (the same paragraph).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32529-stored-expression-inputs.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no ADR-0087 marker (`check-adr-0087-registration` finds no declared-breaking changeset). The ADR-0087 semantic entry of round 0 is deleted with the refusal.
- **File surface beyond the claim's**: `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (rule-id mapping), `packages/lint/src/index.ts` (barrel), `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts` (the #5017 key scan's plumbing table gains `inputs`, `fieldDefs`, `finding`, `typedObjects`), the three `content/docs/data-modeling/*.mdx` sentences, and `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (one CALLERS row classifying the member `not-a-served-read`, as `validate-expressions.ts` is — authorized by the seat; it was CI Test Core's red on `fbd58d8e`).
- **Blueprint comments (carrier named in the #32699 ACCEPT), comment-only after #32699 merged:** the jsdoc over `FORMULA_STORAGE_RULE` in `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` and the comment in the last test of `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts` now say a cross-record stored read is warned at authoring (`stored-expression-cross-record-input`); the describe strings are untouched. `FORMULA_STORAGE_RULE` is not exported, so nothing published moves and the changeset carries no `@objectstack/spec` line.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts` (13 cases): the measured case warned (and the build has no error); the `user`-field hop and the indexed, optional and `record.?a.?b` spellings warned; `record.owner_id.name`, `record.created_by.name` and `record.?owner_id.?name.orValue('')` warned on an object that declares none of them; `ownership: 'none'` control (no `owner_id` injected, not warned; `created_by` still is); a hop through a field an object extension adds warned; same-row, the reference and its `id` admitted; `formula` fields not judged; the volatile cases, `os['user']`, `ctx['user']` and `ctx[?'user']` included.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`, the #32529 / #32554 block (6 cases): the door advises the hop under its own id with no 422, advises the injected `owner_id` hop, a re-save of an object stored with the hop still saves (advisory only), the clock is an advisory, same-row and `formula` controls are clean, door finding equals build finding.
- Ablations (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation and restore proven on disk; the suites import `src`): round 0, arm 1 (`if (reads.length > 0)`) 6 failed / 20 passed and arm 2 (`if (volatile.length > 0)`) 4 failed / 22 passed; round 1, the injected-column line deleted → 3 failed / 27 passed (both injected pins and the `ownership: 'none'` control), the served-body fold replaced by an empty map → 1 failed / 12 passed (the extension pin). Every leg restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Exposure.** In this repository: 0. Measured by running the built `validateStackExpressions` over every first-party config (`examples/app-crm` 1 stored expression field, `app-showcase` 2, `app-todo`, `app-multi-package`, `packages/apps/connector-{docusign,github,stripe}`) → 0 findings of either id, positive control producing both; `packages/qa` fixtures by `git grep` → 0. First-party outside the repository: **1**, HotCRM `src/sales/objects/forecast.object.ts:152` `display_title`, a stored title reading `record.?owner_id.?name` on purpose (ruling #24981 A), counted by triage 6819979060 (HotCRM is not checked out in this session; not re-read here). It now gets the `stored-expression-cross-record-input` warning and is not refused; the pin `record.?owner_id.?name.orValue('')` on an object that does not declare `owner_id` is its shape.
- The prescription `packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` prints for a total over a formula ("a field of its return type with the same `expression`") is unchanged; for an expression with a hop or a volatile input the author now gets the matching warning. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

Readings at `1215cab9c` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`; `origin/main` merged at `8fe2174ca`, after #32699); CI owns the farm.
